pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark brown regions with relatively sharp edge gradients. Patch size is largest on the mid-flank, with significant reduction in spatial area and increased frequency on the visible hind leg.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, interconnected lattice of cream-colored interstitial space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the torso, with slight widening at the intersection points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency textured silhouette visible along the upper neck against the sky background, though pixel-level detail is constrained by resolution.
